purpose: Teach: 一式/公文書/リーク/プロファイル/新旧/未完成/偏向/覆す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、商売道具、絶対、一式、絶対、自分で、絶対、揃えたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we started, my father built every tool and piece of equipment himself, absolutely. That's what I'm asking you to remember.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Weight on each assertion. Quiet authority—not performing, but steady as ground. Pauses between the repeated absolutes. A grandfather passing down, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、公文書、絶対、厳重に、絶対、保管してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've kept every document, every record, with strict care. That's something I'm grateful for.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Respect in the pacing—not rushed. A son acknowledging inheritance. Slight lean forward on 'kept.' The gratitude is genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、情報、絶対、リーク、絶対、絶対なかったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In my father's time, there was never—not once—a single breach of confidence. That's what I'm holding on to.
lines.style: Firmer now. Pride underneath, steady as iron. The repeated negations land with quiet conviction. Slight pause before 'that's what'—like he's being very careful to say it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、プロファイル、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、管理してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've managed every client's information with care and attention. I carry that forward.
lines.style: Calm, almost ritualistic. Each phrase lands with equal weight. The tone is one of stewardship—not burden, but responsibility worn like a well-fitting coat. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、新旧、絶対、社員、絶対、皆、絶対、家族のように、絶対、過ごしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In my father's time, we treated old employees and new ones alike—like family, all of us together. That's how it was.
lines.style: Softer now, a touch of memory. Less force, more warmth. The voice carries nostalgia without sadness. Trailing slightly on 'together'—like he's still there.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代の、本気で、絶対、計画、絶対、未完成、絶対、で残ってしまった部分、絶対、私が、絶対、引き継ぎます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. There are things my father started but didn't finish. I'm taking responsibility for completing them.
lines.style: Gentle but resolute. No hesitation. The word 'completing' carries its own quiet strength. Slight catch of emotion—not dwelled on, just present. A son's promise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、偏向、絶対、ない、絶対、目で、絶対、業界を見ていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father looked at the industry with eyes unclouded by bias. He saw clearly, without prejudice.
lines.style: Almost reverent. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each word chosen carefully. Finality on 'prejudice'—like it's a truth that needs protection. The voice is older here, passing judgment and blessing both.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの精神、本気で、絶対、業界の常識を、絶対、覆す、絶対、力、絶対、を持っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father's spirit—that ability to see past what everyone accepts, to question the way things are—that's something I hold.
lines.style: Quiet conviction closing the circle. Pacing is measured, assured. Not aggressive, but certain. The voice settles on 'hold' like placing something in a safe place. Final, respectful, almost ceremonial.
